name: @govuk-one-login/service-header
description: A header for services using GOV.UK One Login

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src -e njk,js,scss --exec "npm run build-all && http-server"
scripts.build-sass: sass --no-source-map --load-path=node_modules src/styles/service-header.scss dist/styles/service-header.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed --load-path=node_modules src/styles/service-header.scss dist/styles/service-header.min.css && npm run copy-sass-sources
scripts.copy-sass-sources: cp src/styles/_index.scss dist/styles/_index.scss && cp src/styles/service-header.scss dist/styles/service-header.scss && cp src/styles/service-header.import.scss dist/styles/service-header.import.scss
scripts.build-all: npm run build-sass && npm run build-templates && npm run copy-govuk-assets
